title: Semantics of a Halving Step
statement: Let $A$ be a nondeterministic register machine with oracle, input, guard $G$, and probability $p$. Suppose its instruction at control state $l$ is the deterministic instruction that replaces register $r$ by $\lfloor v(r)/2\rfloor$ and moves to $l'$. If the current configuration satisfies $G$ and the resulting configuration has probabilistic semantics with probability $p$, then the current configuration also has probabilistic semantics with probability $p$.
hypotheses_covered: Instruction at $l$ is the deterministic halving of register $r$ with successor $l'$
$G$ holds at the current live configuration with no answer recorded
The halved successor configuration has probabilistic semantics with probability $p$
